setupHelp: Set both variables in .env.local using .env.example, then restart the server. Read the README before applying migrations.
resetSent: If this account exists, a password reset link has been sent.
authError: Authentication failed. Check your credentials, connection and Supabase configuration.
dashboardHelp: Figures reflect the records accessible to your account.
loadError: Could not load data. Check connection, migrations and Supabase permissions.
saveError: Could not save. Check fields, relations and Supabase permissions.
deleteError: Could not delete. A linked record may prevent deletion.
dateError: The appointment must end after it starts.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete?
deleteHelp: This is permanent. Effects on linked records depend on your database rules.
statusHelp: Status and type values are stored exactly as entered.
name: Name
title: Title
paymentHelp: General terms or terms for a specific project.
paymentPlaceholder: Describe the agreed stages, deadlines and payment arrangements.
paymentLoadError: Could not load payment terms. Check connection and permissions.
paymentSetupHelp: The section is ready. Add its storage table in Supabase using the supplied script. Terms cannot be saved before activation.
sheetHelp: Headings are fixed. Enter shekel amounts: euros are calculated automatically using the latest official published rate.
paymentValueError: Check amounts: non-negative numbers with up to two decimal places. The template cannot exceed 20,000 characters.
pdfInstructions: The PDF will download directly to your computer.
quoteFooter: Indicative quotation — amounts and terms subject to confirmation. Conversion uses the displayed rate and date.
pdfError: PDF generation failed. Retry; no empty file was downloaded.
unlinkConfirm: Are you sure you want to unlink this apartment from the prospect? The apartment will remain in the CRM.
projectImagesHelp: Click an image to open it full size. Photos and renderings from the project website.
planLoadError: The plan could not be displayed. Use the link to open the source file.
sharePlanHelp: The message includes the plan link. Choose the recipient and confirm sending in your app.
photoShareHelp: Choose your app in the sharing menu to send the photo. If your browser cannot share attachments, the photo will download.
photoError: Unable to prepare or share the photo. Try again or open the full-size plan.
photoDownloaded: Photo downloaded: attach this file in your email app or WhatsApp.
inviteEmployeeHelp: The employee receives an email link to choose a password. They can access only their assigned prospects.
teamError: Unable to complete the action. Retry or check team configuration.
adminConfiguration: Employee invitations must be enabled by the site administrator.
alreadyMember: This account is already on the team.
inviteFailed: Invitation failed. Check the email address, email service and Supabase sending limits.
provisionFailed: Invitation created but employee access is incomplete. Contact the Supabase administrator before retrying.
importHelp: Choose an Excel (.xlsx), CSV or text file. Review rows and assign agents before confirming.
importYear: Year for dates without a year
importFallbackDate: Date for rows without a date
importFileError: Invalid file: use .xlsx, CSV or text without formulas, up to 5 MB and 5,000 rows.
importSaveError: Import failed. Check permissions and the Supabase migration.
importIgnoredHelp: Duplicates and invalid rows are skipped. Existing prospects remain unchanged.
importSwapped: Ready · email and phone restored to their columns
chatLoadError: Unable to load messages. Try again shortly.
chatSetupHelp: The administrator must activate messaging in Supabase. No message has been created yet.
chatOpenError: Unable to open this conversation. Check that your colleague is still active.
chatSendError: Your message could not be sent. Your text has been kept.
chatTeamHelp: All active members can read and write in this group.
chatPrivateHelp: Private conversation: only the two participants can access these messages.
chatIntro: Talk to your colleagues or the whole team.
chooseApartmentFilters: Choose your criteria, then click Search to display apartments.
aiIntro: Ask about records available to your account. The assistant reads the CRM without changing data.
aiExample: Which apartments are available in Ashdod?
aiConsent: I agree to send my questions and queried records to the AI provider to generate answers.
aiSetup: The assistant is ready, but an administrator must configure the AI service key.
aiError: Unable to answer right now. Try again.
aiLimit: The AI service limit has been reached. Try later.
securityHelp: Protect your account with a temporary code from an app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
securityScan: Scan this QR code in your Authenticator app, then enter its six-digit code.
securityChallenge: Enter your Authenticator code to access the CRM.
securityError: Verification failed. Try again with a new code.
dossierHelp: Files and apartments are attached to this project. Administrator actions only.
dossierFilesHelp: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP. Up to 30 files per upload, 20 MB each. A folder must contain only these formats. Files remain private under Supabase permissions.
dossierApartmentsHelp: Text PDF, CSV, TSV, XLSX or JSON, up to 5 MB and 1,000 apartments. Number or reference required. Template areas in m², prices in ₪. Text PDF tables are extracted for review; plans and scans remain attachments. JSON accepts an array or an apartments property. Existing apartments are never replaced.
dossierConfirm: Confirm adding {count} apartments to this project
dossierLoadError: Could not load documents. Check connectivity and permissions.
dossierFileError: Choose up to 30 nonempty PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP files, at most 20 MB each.
dossierUploadError: Upload stopped after {count} saved files. Remaining files can be retried. Check documents storage and permissions.
dossierCleanupError: A file was uploaded but its record failed and cleanup failed. Contact the administrator before retrying.
dossierDownloadError: Download failed. Check connectivity and file permissions.
dossierDuplicate: Import blocked: duplicate number or reference in the file or already present in this project.
dossierImportError: Invalid file. Use the template and check identifiers, numbers and limits. Excel formulas are not accepted.
dossierSaveError: Import not confirmed. Reload the table before retrying to check for duplicates. Check permissions and database constraints.
dossierSaveFirst: Save the project, then use “Add apartment dossier” in its detail page to attach plans and import apartments.
dossierPdfReview: Extracted tables from {tablePages} of {pages} pages. Check every row against the PDF: other layouts may leave apartments or values unrecognized. Expected prices in ₪ and areas in m². Nothing is added before confirmation.
dossierPdfError: Extraction failed or values need correction. Use a text PDF with a table and Number/Reference, Rooms, Area and Price columns, or the CSV template. Drawn plans and scans without text are not converted. Maximum: 5 MB and 50 pages.
dossierFileSaved: File saved in the selected folder.
dossierDownloadStarted: Download sent to the browser. Open its downloads (Ctrl+J) to find the file or show its folder. The location depends on browser settings.
dossierPreviewError: Could not display this file. Check connectivity and permissions, or download it to open it.
dossierPdfPreviewHelp: If your browser cannot display PDFs, close this preview and use Download.
platformHelp: Agency management is restricted to platform administrators. Each new agency starts with a 14-day trial; automatic billing is not enabled.
platformSlugHelp: 2 to 63 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Example: paris-agency.
platformCreated: Agency created. Invite its administrator using that agency’s form.
platformLoadError: Unable to load the platform. Check your session and SaaS configuration.
platformCreateError: Unable to create agency. Check the fields and choose a unique identifier.
platformInviteHelp: Use their existing email address. They receive a link to choose a password and become administrator of this agency only.
platformInviteSent: Invitation sent to {email}. The account is assigned to {agency}.
platformInviteSetup: Invitations are not configured: set the server-only SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Vercel, then redeploy.
platformInviteSession: Session expired. Sign in again before retrying.
platformInviteInvalid: Check the name, email address and active agency access.
platformInviteExists: This address already belongs to an agency. No account was moved.
platformInviteEmailError: The invitation email was refused. Check whether this address already has an account, plus Supabase email and redirect URL settings.
platformInviteProvision: An email may have been sent, but agency assignment failed. Do not resend: have the account and crm_register_invited_member function checked in Supabase.
platformInviteLimit: Too many invitations. Wait before retrying.
platformInviteError: Unable to invite. Check SaaS configuration and diagnose before retrying.
platformInviteUncertain: The send outcome is unknown. Check the account in Supabase before resending an invitation.
platformInviteDisabled: Invitations are disabled for suspended agencies or expired access.
